subject.title: Feature: Add per-model generation timeout config

question: Should OpenClaw expose a model-specific non-resetting deadline, and should that public override live in the canonical provider model catalog or in `agents.defaults.models`?
rationale: Current source proves the behavioral gap, but choosing the public config owner and composition with provider and whole-run budgets is an API and product decision.

options.title: Canonical model deadline
options.body: Add a model-level hard deadline resolved over provider defaults and capped by the remaining whole-run budget, using one timeout-classification path.

options.title: Agent routing override
options.body: Expose the hard deadline only in `agents.defaults.models`, allowing agent-specific budgets but creating a separate owner from provider model configuration.

options.title: Keep existing timers
options.body: Decline a new deadline and address runaway output through provider/run limits and the separate semantic repetition safeguard.

recommendation.title: Canonical model deadline
recommendation.body: Add a model-level hard deadline resolved over provider defaults and capped by the remaining whole-run budget, using one timeout-classification path.

likelyOwner.reason: He supplied the detailed maintainer-side contract review and introduced the current configuration-module split containing this surface.
